matches.key_issue: none; home response to first-leg deficit was captured
overweighted home advantage and comeback narrative; underweighted Inter's 2-0 first-leg lead and qualification-state incentives
treated away favorite and first-leg lead as sufficient for away win; underweighted draw probability in a low-event second leg

lessons: A first-leg lead predicts qualification/game state, not automatically an away win.
A team trailing 0-2 at home may create pressure but can also be vulnerable to counterattacks; home advantage must not override opponent strength.
In low-total-goal second legs, X should receive more probability and may be a jackpot-value candidate.
The model probabilities were too compressed: Flora home 0.50 vs away 0.25 and Ilves away 0.55 vs draw 0.20 did not reflect enough draw/upset risk.
For a 4-match test coupon, Flora and Ilves should have been doubles rather than unprotected singles unless confidence was materially higher.
